workflow_details.description: Add information that will help to differentiate this workflow from another.
workflow_details.title: Workflow Details

time_range.description: Choose the period of time to analyze.
time_range.title: Time Range

data_source.description: Select one of your configured data sources.
Select one of your configured data sources.

var.title: Subject Group Name
var.description: The EarthRanger subject group to map, picked from the chosen data source's subject groups.

Previous Period.description: Define the comparison ("previous") period to contrast against your selected time range. Every option below computes a period that ends on your time range's Start Date, then works backward to determine its Start Date. By default this is Preset → Same as current period (a period of the same length as your time range). Choose another Preset for a common lookback (1, 3 or 6 months, or 1 year back), Custom to enter your own Years / Months / Weeks / Days offset, or Calendar to pick an exact Start Date.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Choose how to calculate the comparison period's Start Date. In every mode, the comparison period ends on your selected time range's Start Date (so it never overlaps with the current period) — only the Start Date changes.

Trajectory Segment Filter.description: Filter trajectory segments based on criteria like minimum/maximum length, duration and speed. This helps remove GPS noise and unrealistic movements. The same filter will be applied to both current and previous trajectories to ensure consistency in the analysis.

min_length_meters.title: Minimum Segment Length (m)
min_length_meters.description: Discard segments shorter than this distance. Helps remove GPS noise and stationary fixes.

max_length_meters.title: Maximum Segment Length (m)
max_length_meters.description: Discard segments longer than this distance. Helps remove unrealistic long-distance jumps.

min_time_secs.title: Minimum Segment Duration (s)
min_time_secs.description: Discard segments with a duration shorter than this (in seconds).

max_time_secs.title: Maximum Segment Duration (s)
max_time_secs.description: Discard segments with a duration longer than this (in seconds). Default is 6 hours (21,600 s).

min_speed_kmhr.title: Minimum Speed (km/h)
min_speed_kmhr.description: Discard segments where average speed falls below this value.

max_speed_kmhr.title: Maximum Speed (km/h)
max_speed_kmhr.description: Discard segments where average speed exceeds this value. For elephants, 9 km/h is a sensible ceiling.

Map Zoom & Extent.description: Calculate the geographic extent of the movement tracks and determine an appropriate zoom level and center point for the map. This ensures that all tracks are visible and well-framed when the map is rendered.

expansion_factor.title: Expansion Factor
expansion_factor.description: Factor to expand the bounding box (e.g., 1.2 = 20% larger)

Mean Speed Raster.description: Configure how the mean speed raster is generated from movement trajectories.

step_length.title: Step Length (m)
step_length.description: Sets the pixel (cell) size of the mean speed raster, in meters. Smaller values produce a more detailed raster but take longer to generate and produce larger files; larger values produce a coarser raster. Enter a fixed value (default 2000 m), or choose "Auto" to let the system use the average distance between consecutive GPS fixes instead.

since.description: Pick the exact Start Date for the comparison period.
since.title: Since

years.title: Years
years.description: Whole years to go back from your time range's start date.

months.title: Months
months.description: Whole months to go back from your time range's start date.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: Whole weeks to go back from your time range's start date.

days.title: Days
days.description: Whole days to go back from your time range's start date.

CustomPreviousPeriod.title: Custom
CustomPreviousPeriod.description: Manually set how far back the comparison period's Start Date should be, counted backward from your time range's start date. For example, the default (Months = 1) creates a comparison period covering the month immediately before your report's start date.

preset.description: Choose a common lookback period, counted backward from your time range's start date. "Same as current period" (the default) uses a comparison period of the same length as your time range, ending on its start date.
preset.title: Preset
